title: ATP and WTA match results in Jeff Sackmann's CSV columns

sackmannFile.title: File
sackmannFile.description: matches = played matches of the seasons or dates below; upcoming = today's and tomorrow's scheduled singles in his tournament and player columns, with both players' rank, seed, Elo and the Elo win probability; new-results = only the matches that finished since your last run with the same tours, each once, usually complete with statistics and Elo (schedule it daily, at least weekly; the first run returns today and the 10 days before). Upcoming and new results use Tours and Max results; Years and the days apply to played matches.
enumTitles: New results since the last run

years.title: Years
years.description: The seasons, e.g. [2024, 2025] (from 1990). Empty = the From / To days below, or this season so far.

tours.title: Tours
tours.description: atp = his atp_matches files, wta = wta_matches, challenger-men = qual_chall, itf-men = futures. Empty = ATP and WTA.

dateFrom.title: From day (UTC)
dateFrom.description: Used when Years is empty: the first day, e.g. 2026-01-01 or -7 (seven days ago). Empty Years and From = this season so far.

dateTo.title: To day (UTC)
dateTo.description: Used when Years is empty: the last day, inclusive. Empty = today.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum matches to return. A full ATP season is about 4,300 matches with qualifying, WTA about 3,800.
